Tuition & Financial Aid

Online Master’s Tuition and Financial Aid

Advanced technical expertise can create new possibilities for your career. New York Tech offers online master’s programs in artificial intelligence and data science designed to help you deepen your knowledge while continuing to work.

Each program requires 30 credit hours. Tuition rates are outlined in the chart below.*

2026–2027 Academic Year
Online Data Science, M.S. Online Artificial Intelligence, M.S.
Total Credits 30 30
Cost Per Credit $1,350 $1,350
Application Fee $50 $50
Graduate Fee (per 7-week cycle) $160 $160

*Tuition and costs are subject to change and should be confirmed on the University’s official tuition listing at nyit.edu/bursar/graduate_tuition_fees. Tuition rates are not inclusive of textbooks and fees.

*Online Data Science, M.S. students who do not have a sufficient background will be required to take two prerequisite courses in programming and statistics before starting the core curriculum. A linear algebra course must also be completed within the first six months of the program. Students may be able to satisfy this prerequisite with previous education. Reach out to your admissions outreach advisor for a transcript evaluation.

Types of Aid

Federal Student Aid

If you are interested in requesting financial aid for your online master's program, we ask that you file the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA). New York Institute of Technology’s Federal School code is 002782.
  • Complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)

Note: Applicants may need tax and financial information to complete the FAFSA. The IRS Direct Data Exchange (or applicable IRS data-sharing tools) may help streamline the application process and improve data accuracy.

External Scholarships

In addition to institutional, state, and federal funding opportunities, students may be eligible for external scholarships that can help support their educational expenses.

Please visit the External Scholarships page for a list of some outside scholarships to help begin your search.

Loan Options

Private education loans may be available to students and families seeking additional funding for educational expenses. Loan terms, eligibility requirements, and interest rates vary by lender and borrower qualifications.

Students are encouraged to carefully compare available loan options and understand all borrowing and repayment responsibilities before making a decision.

ELMSelect provides a lender comparison tool that allows students to review private loan options, compare terms and benefits, and identify lenders that best meet their financing needs.
  • Please visit the New York Institute of Technology ELMSelect Graduate School page to learn more. 

Military Benefits

New York Tech proudly participates in the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Yellow Ribbon Program.

Military-affiliated students may qualify for additional benefits, including the Yellow Ribbon Program. Students must meet Satisfactory Academic Progress to be eligible for veteran benefits. For more information, contact the following agencies:
  • U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA)
  • GI BILL®
  • NY State Veterans
  • Office of the Registrar at the Long Island campus, email: registrar@nyit.edu 
  • HESC Veterans Tuition Award (VTA) (NYS Code for New York Institute of Technology is 5455 for graduate students)
  • Yellow Ribbon GI Education Enhancement Program
  • Transfer of Post-9/11 GI BILL® Benefits to Dependents

Billing Schedule

Tuition for New York Tech is due on fixed dates before the start of each semester. A late fee of $400 applies to balances not covered by the due date. You can view and pay bills directly through the New York Tech Student Service HUB.

Key Billing Deadlines

  • Fall Semester: August 1
  • Spring Semester: January 1
  • Summer Semester: May 1

Before planning your start term, review the Online Data Science admissions requirements, required application materials, and current deadlines.
